full_judgment: 2. The facts relevant for disposal of the Rule, in short, is that the complainant Ahmed Noor alias Tanu Mia lodged a petition of complaint before the Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Chittagong against two accused, naming the present petitioner in serial No. 1 along with one Sisu Mia (Non petitioner) alleging, inter-alia, that 12 gandas of land of plot Nos. 51 at 211 of RS khatian No. 9, Plot No. 70/Ka 752 of RS khatian No. 1222, plot No. 1750/Kha 673, 1750/Kha, 672 and 1750 of RS khatian No. 1750 originally belonged to SM Jahirul Islam alias Jahirul Islam from whom the complainant had purchased the said land by a registered kabala being No. 1974 dated 3-5-1983. On 14-12-1990 the accused persons along with their some accomplice being armed with lethal weapons, trespassing into the said land cut the paddy and took an attempt to take away the same from the land. The land was cultivated by Karuna, the borgader of the complainant who tried to resist the accused but failed. The complainant being informed of the said occurrence through his borgader Karuna having been in the paddy field found the accused to cut and to take away the paddy. Accused Nurul Haque threatened him of dire consequence showing a kiris. The complainant in order to save his life had left the place of occurrence, the other witnesses also unsuccessfully tried to resist them. The accused took away the paddy at a worth of Taka 1500. The complainant before the said occurrence being aware of the motive of the accused lodged a GD entry being GD entry No. 241 dated 7-12-1990 against the accused in the concerned Police Station.
